sources.title: Statistical release calendar 2026
facts: Calendar lists Telecommunications Market Data Update Q4 2025 for 16 April 2026
Calendar describes telecoms market sizing statistics and downloadable data
Calendar lists Telecoms and Pay-TV Complaints Q4 2025 for 11 May 2026
Complaint releases compare major providers using complaints per 100,000 subscribers
limitations: A release calendar is lineage evidence, not the underlying statistic
Scheduled or published datasets do not establish parcel availability

sources.title: The Communications Market 2026
sources.evidence_kind: communications market report portal and downloads
sources.evidence_location: official HTML report description and data-download list
facts: The report is an interactive data portal
It combines industry data, Ofcom consumer research and selected third-party headline figures
Ofcom provides a short summary of key findings
The page lists telecoms-data and other CSV downloads
limitations: Market-level data cannot be assigned to an individual parcel
PDF summary internals were not used

sources.title: Communications Market Report 2026: Interactive data
sources.evidence_location: official HTML market-context and telecoms sections
facts: The portal includes affordability research and service take-up charts
The telecoms section includes revenues, volumes and market shares
The telecoms section includes average monthly spend data
The telecoms section includes home broadband performance and technology-tracker research
limitations: Interactive chart series remain aggregate research
Market and performance charts are not address-level orderability

sources.title: Mayor of London and London Councils unveil new London Infrastructure Framework to drive growth
sources.evidence_location: official HTML summary and framework purpose
facts: Framework was launched on 16 March 2026
It covers digital connectivity networks alongside transport, energy, water and waste
It seeks sector collaboration to support London growth
The announcement states greater infrastructure investment is needed
limitations: Strategic framework is not broadband coverage or delivery evidence
No parcel or provider orderability inference is permitted
sources.licence: London City Hall official HTML; attribution retained

sources.title: ADD2852 Infrastructure work programme for 26-27
sources.evidence_location: official HTML key information and executive summary
facts: Decision reference is ADD2852
Decision was signed on 1 July 2026 and published on 8 July 2026
It covers GLA Infrastructure team projects for 2026-27
It authorises funding and expenditure for the Upgrading London's Infrastructure delivery plan
limitations: Programme funding does not prove broadband build completion
Project-level decision cannot be assigned to a parcel
